title: Books-table schema duplicated in two places
evidence: app.py:20 _ensure_table and app.py:43 init_db both contain the same CREATE TABLE books DDL
suggestion: Have init_db call _ensure_table (or share a single DDL constant) so the schema is defined once

title: year/isbn accepted without type validation
evidence: app.py:77-78 reads data.get('year'/'isbn') and inserts verbatim; only title/author are validated (app.py:72-75)
suggestion: Optional: coerce/validate year as integer. Not required by the spec (only title/author are mandatory).
